caveats: Data read from the consolidated file icsa2027_data_20261101T090944Z/s2z/sst_s2.nc (1982-01-01..2023-12-31, verified identical to the daily s1z files for overlapping dates); the 1000 daily files in s1z cover only 1982-01-01..1984-09-26 and were not needed. Region grid cells: 60x60 (lat 56.14..57.32, lon 17.72..18.90, 0.02 deg grid); 3300 sea cells (finite SST on all 92 target days), 300 land cells (NaN) set to 0. All sea cells were complete over the 1992-2002 baseline, so every threshold/climatology pool had 121 valid values. Method: 90th percentile per day-of-year (MATLAB-default hazen/Type-5 quantile), day 60 set to the mean of days 59 and 61, then circular centred 31-day mean; hot = SST(K) >= threshold; per-cell MHW = >=5 consecutive hot days, runs separated by <=2 non-hot days joined (gap days included). All computations in float64.
